warnings.message: Document contains no explicit per-lot CPV codes. CPVs (44221300-8 Gates, 44400000-4 Miscellaneous fabricated products, 45223100-7 Assembly of metal structures) were attached from the notice main_category and mapped to lots by relevance (gates CPV excluded from Lot 3 fabrication-only and Lot 5 chute-only where it did not fit).
Docling extraction returned page_count=0 for this document (Word-sourced .docx); page_ref values use section/table-row references instead of page numbers.

Notice summary enumerates only Lots 1-3 for the Metal Works DPS, but Appendix 1 Evaluation Criteria explicitly defines five lots (1-5). Per the skill's input rules, the document is treated as authoritative over notice metadata.

This Appendix 1 is an evaluation-criteria document, not a product specification. product_requirement_seeds capture categories of items (e.g. 'bespoke signs', 'handrails') mentioned in lot descriptions, without dimensional/material/finish attributes. Downstream product-matching must treat these as generic category seeds, not SKU-level requirements.

Section 2 Award Criteria states 'A separate appendix will be provided which will set out the evaluation approach to Social Value.' That Social Value appendix is not present in this document; Social Value is modelled here only as a 20% award-criterion weighting.
Award-criteria weightings for ≥£25,000 call-offs are expressed as ranges (Price 20-80%, Quality 0-60%, Social Value 20%); exact weightings are tailored per individual ITT at call-off stage.

Document is primarily selection/award criteria for DPS admission. It is marked document_role=technical_specification upstream; caller should be aware that detailed product/technical attributes expected of a 'tender specification' are absent here — this is an evaluation-criteria appendix.
